feature_requests.title: Strategy Edge Decay Chart (rolling expectancy by strategy)

Lets me kill or down-size strategies whose edge has decayed before the monthly P&L tells me. Today the monthly report is lagging — this is the leading indicator.

feature_requests.title: Plan vs Actual Reconciliation Report
feature_requests.rationale: For every AI-generated plan (directional, straddle, pyramid, spread), compare planned entry/SL/target/size vs what actually executed and the realised outcome. Surfaces slippage, sizing drift, and SL-honour rate. Without this I can't tell if the AI plans are good and execution is bad, or vice versa.

feature_requests.title: Options Greeks Heatmap (portfolio-level delta/gamma/theta/vega)
feature_requests.rationale: Live aggregated Greeks across ALL open option positions (straddles + pyramids + spreads) by underlying and expiry bucket, with a gamma-risk badge for expiry-day positions. Unlocks the 'should I hedge or close before 3:15' decision — currently I have to eyeball positions one-by-one.

feature_requests.title: Signal-to-Trade Funnel (capture-rate breakdown)
feature_requests.rationale: Funnel view: signals fired → passed risk gate → executed → profitable, sliced by strategy and rejection reason from @RiskGuard. Tells me whether I'm leaving edge on the table due to over-tight risk limits or capital cap. Complements the monthly capture matrix but live/intraday instead of EOD.

feature_requests.title: Daily Risk Budget & Drawdown Anatomy
feature_requests.rationale: Top-of-screen tile showing today's used vs allowed risk (1% per trade, 3% daily loss cap), open-trade risk-at-stop, and a 30-day intraday-drawdown waterfall sliced by strategy + workflow. Lets me decide instantly whether to take the next setup or stop trading for the day, and which strategy is bleeding the daily budget.

feature_requests.title: Theta Decay & Premium-Burn Forecast Curve
feature_requests.rationale: For all open short-premium positions (straddles + short legs of spreads), project per-minute theta capture vs realised P&L till 3:15 PM, with a 'breakeven move in underlying' band overlaid. Tells me whether the position is still worth holding for theta or if I'm now net-short gamma without enough premium left to justify the risk.

feature_requests.title: Expiry-Day Tactical Cockpit (NIFTY Tue / SENSEX Thu)
feature_requests.rationale: Dedicated screen that auto-activates on expiry days: time-to-3:15PM countdown, ATM pin probability, gamma exposure by strike, mandatory close-list with one-click square-off, and a forced-flat checklist by 3:10 PM. feature_requests.title: Broker vs Journal Reconciliation Report
feature_requests.rationale: End-of-day diff between Angel One ledger (positions, charges, realised P&L, margin used) and our internal TradeJournal + PortfolioSnapshot. Surfaces missed fills, ghost positions, brokerage drag eating edge, and silent paper-vs-live divergence — critical before scaling capital from 5L upward.

feature_requests.title: Regime-Conditioned Strategy Allocation Heatmap
feature_requests.rationale: Matrix of strategy × NIFTY regime (trending up / trending down / chop / high-VIX / low-VIX) showing historical expectancy and trade count in each cell, plus today's detected regime highlighted. Tells me which strategies to enable/disable at 9:15 AM based on the morning regime read instead of running everything blindly.

feature_requests.title: Liquidity & Slippage Cost Map (per-symbol bid-ask + impact)
feature_requests.rationale: Show live bid-ask spread, 5-level depth imbalance, and historical fill-vs-mid slippage for every symbol on the watchlist + open positions. Tells me which strikes/stocks are safe to scale into and which will eat 30+ bps on exit — critical for SENSEX/BANKNIFTY options where depth is thin and for sizing the 4th pyramid leg.

feature_requests.title: Cross-Position Correlation & Concentration Matrix
feature_requests.rationale: Heatmap of pairwise return correlation between every open position (equity + options delta-adjusted) plus a 'true independent bets' count and sector/factor concentration bars. Unlocks the decision of whether adding another BANKNIFTY pyramid or HDFCBANK long is a new bet or just leveraging the same exposure 3x — directly informs the daily risk cap.

feature_requests.title: What-If Position Sizer & Pre-Trade Impact Simulator
feature_requests.rationale: Interactive panel where I dial lots/qty and instantly see post-trade portfolio delta, margin used, free cash, leverage ratio, distance to 3% daily-loss cap, and worst-case loss-at-stop. Today I have to mentally combine 4 cockpits to know if 'one more lot' breaks a limit — this collapses that into one slider before I click Buy.

feature_requests.title: Trade Post-Mortem Auto-Annotator (loss attribution by cause)
feature_requests.rationale: Per closed trade, classify the outcome driver: SL too tight, exit too early, sizing too small, slippage, news shock, regime mismatch, or thesis wrong — with the supporting chart + plan-vs-actual data inline. Daily/weekly roll-up converts vague 'I should improve' into a ranked checklist of behavioural fixes that compounds edge over months.

feature_requests.title: Overnight Gap Risk & Pre-Market Exposure Dashboard
feature_requests.rationale: For positions held overnight (monthly F&O, swing equity, carried straddles), show implied gap from SGX NIFTY + Dow + ADRs + overnight option chain skew, with projected P&L at +/-0.5/1/2% gaps and a 'forced action before 9:15' list. Lets me decide at 8:45 AM IST whether to hedge with futures, trim, or stand pat — currently this is a manual scramble across 5 browser tabs.

feature_requests.title: Live Skew & Term-Structure Surface (25Δ RR, fly, ATM IV per expiry)
feature_requests.rationale: Single panel showing 25-delta risk-reversal and butterfly across the next 4 NIFTY + BANKNIFTY weekly/monthly expiries, plus ATM IV term-structure slope. Lets me see when puts are bid (fear) vs calls (squeeze) and whether the front-week is rich vs back-month — the entry signal for calendars, diagonals, and skew trades.

feature_requests.title: IV Rank & IV Percentile Board (rolling 30/60/252d per expiry bucket)
feature_requests.rationale: Per-underlying IV rank for ATM, 25Δ wings, and realised-vs-implied spread bucketed by DTE. Tells me instantly whether to be a premium seller (high IV rank) or a buyer (low rank), and flags IV crush windows around RBI/Fed/earnings so I scale straddles correctly.

feature_requests.title: Greeks-Overlay Payoff Builder with Live Δ/Γ/Θ/Vega Heatmap
feature_requests.rationale: Interactive payoff diagram for any straddle/strangle/spread/iron-condor with per-strike greeks coloured along the price-time grid, T+0 / T+1 / expiry curves, and a vega-shock toggle (+/-2 vol pts). Replaces the mental math I do today before scaling or rolling — shows where gamma punishes me and where theta actually accrues.

feature_requests.title: Portfolio Delta-Drift Monitor with Auto-Hedge Suggestions
feature_requests.rationale: Live aggregate Δ across all open option positions with a tolerance band (e.g. ±0.10 of notional); when drift breaches, propose the cheapest hedge (futures lots vs ATM option vs offsetting strike) ranked by theta cost and margin impact. Keeps short straddles/strangles delta-neutral without me re-hedging manually every 20 minutes.

feature_requests.title: Expiry-Day Pin-Risk & Max-Pain Tracker (intraday OI migration)
feature_requests.rationale: On NIFTY Tue / SENSEX Thu, plot max-pain strike, gamma-flip level, and OI add/unwind by strike every 5 min, with alerts when spot is within 0.25% of a high-gamma strike inside the last 90 minutes. Critical for sized short-gamma books — tells me when to flatten vs let theta finish.

feature_requests.title: Capital Deployment Allocation Wheel (bucket × instrument × expiry)
feature_requests.rationale: Sunburst showing exactly how my 500k is parked: equity intraday vs monthly F&O vs weekly options vs free cash, then sliced by underlying and DTE bucket. Today I have no single view of 'where is my capital right now' — I infer it from positions + margin. This unlocks the decision to rebalance before adding a correlated new trade.

feature_requests.title: SPAN+Exposure Stress-Test Cockpit (spot ±1/2/3% & vol ±2pts)
feature_requests.rationale: Live margin used, free cash, and SPAN+exposure projected under spot and vol shocks, with a margin-call probability per scenario. The existing risk-budget tile covers 1%/3% loss caps but says nothing about leverage breaking under a gap. Lets me know if I can carry another lot or must trim before close.

feature_requests.title: Event & Earnings Risk Calendar Overlay (30-day forward)
feature_requests.rationale: Forward calendar with RBI policy, Fed FOMC, budget, expiry, and earnings for every held equity name, flagged by my open position size. I currently learn about these from Telegram or by accident. This unlocks pre-event hedge/trim decisions instead of post-event regret.

feature_requests.title: Realized vs Implied Vol Edge Tracker (RV-IV spread regime bands)
feature_requests.rationale: Per-underlying time series of 20d realized vol vs ATM IV, with regime bands (premium-rich, fair, premium-poor) so I can size short-vol trades only when the edge is statistically there. IV-rank board (already requested) tells me the level; this tells me whether the level is justified — the difference between a trade and a fade.

feature_requests.title: Kelly-Optimal Sizing Recommender per Strategy
feature_requests.rationale: From historical SignalLog + TradeJournal, compute per-strategy edge, win rate, and payoff ratio, then surface full-Kelly + fractional-Kelly (0.25x/0.5x) recommended bet size vs what I'm actually deploying. Tells me which strategies I'm starving and which I'm over-betting given their realized edge.

feature_requests.title: Live IV Term Structure & IV Rank Board (next 4 weekly expiries)

feature_requests.title: 25-Delta Risk-Reversal & Butterfly Skew Snapshot
feature_requests.rationale: Show live 25Δ put-call skew and 25Δ butterfly per expiry with intraday timeline and 20d Z-score. Skew steepening on NIFTY weeklies is my earliest signal that put protection is being bid — I want to fade or align with it instead of guessing from the chain.

feature_requests.title: Dealer Gamma Exposure (GEX) Map by Strike
feature_requests.rationale: Compute aggregate dealer gamma per strike from OI × gamma × contract multiplier, mark zero-gamma flip level, and overlay spot. feature_requests.title: Realized-vs-Implied Edge Per Expiry with Forward P&L Projection

feature_requests.title: Event-Driven IV Crush Playbook (FOMC/RBI/Budget/Earnings)

feature_requests.title: Live Basis & Cost-of-Carry Monitor (spot vs current/next futures)

feature_requests.title: OI vs Price Quadrant Heatmap (Long/Short Build-up & Unwind)

feature_requests.title: Roll-Day Calendar & Current-vs-Next Spread Tracker

feature_requests.title: SPAN+ELM Margin Efficiency Table (notional-per-margin per symbol)

feature_requests.title: VWAP-Deviation Bands & Mean-Reversion Alert Strip

feature_requests.title: Slippage-vs-Edge Calculator per Setup (go/no-go before click)

feature_requests.title: 3:20 PM Forced-Flat Checklist & Auto-Square-Off Cockpit

feature_requests.title: Portfolio Exposure Decomposition (gross/net/beta/sector/factor)
feature_requests.rationale: Single screen breaking total capital into gross exposure, net long/short, beta-weighted-to-NIFTY, sector concentration, and factor tilts (momentum/value/lowvol). feature_requests.title: Capital-at-Risk Heat Strip (open R + theoretical max loss per book)
feature_requests.rationale: Live strip showing for each book (equity intraday / monthly F&O / weekly straddle / pyramid) the open R remaining to SL, theoretical max loss if everything gaps to worst-case, and % of daily-loss-budget consumed. Lets me answer 'can I take one more trade?' in 2 seconds instead of mentally summing across cockpits.

feature_requests.title: Regime Dashboard (VIX term-structure + breadth + trend-day probability)
feature_requests.rationale: Top-of-app banner showing INDIA VIX level + 1d/5d delta, VIX futures term structure slope, NSE advance-decline + new-highs-vs-lows, and a Bayesian trend-day-probability for today based on opening-30m range vs 20-day ATR. feature_requests.title: Correlation-Adjusted Position Sizer (cluster risk before adding)

feature_requests.title: Live Skew & Term-Structure Surface (25Δ RR, fly, IV-rank per expiry)
feature_requests.rationale: Snapshot every 30s of NIFTY/BANKNIFTY ATM IV + 25Δ put/call IV across the next 4 weekly + 2 monthly expiries, with risk-reversal (put-call skew), butterfly, and IV-rank vs 60-day range per expiry. feature_requests.title: Live Greeks Aggregator & Delta-Drift Hedge Suggestor
feature_requests.rationale: Real-time per-position and portfolio-aggregated Δ/Γ/Θ/Vega/Vanna with a configurable delta band (e.g. ±0.15 of one lot). feature_requests.title: Realised-vs-Implied Vol Ribbon (5m / 1d / 5d with HV-IV spread)

feature_requests.title: Expiry-Day Pin-Risk Radar (max-pain, OI walls, gamma flip)
feature_requests.rationale: Tuesday/Thursday-only cockpit showing live max-pain strike, top-3 OI walls on CE & PE, dealer gamma-exposure profile, and a pin-probability score for the next 60/120/240 minutes. feature_requests.title: Per-Strategy Theta-Burn & Vega-Bleed Schedule

feature_requests.title: OI Quadrant Heatmap (long build-up / short cover / long unwind / short build-up)

feature_requests.title: Roll-Spread Calendar & Rollover Cost Tracker

Shows where my vol-selling edge actually lives (and where it's negative). Decision unlocked: cut entries from buckets where realised has been beating implied for 20+ trades.

feature_requests.title: Per-Strategy Theta-Burn & Decay Schedule (hour-by-hour)
feature_requests.rationale: For each open short-premium position show today's expected theta in ₹, realised decay so far, decay-vs-schedule deviation, and an hourly burn-curve from entry to expiry (accounting for weekend decay and Tuesday/Thursday expiry calendar). Highlights when realised decay lags schedule — usually means IV is creeping or gamma is hurting. Decision unlocked: roll or close when 2-day decay is <50% of expected.

feature_requests.title: Live Basis & Cost-of-Carry Monitor (spot vs current/next-month futures)
feature_requests.rationale: Real-time panel showing spot, current-month future, next-month future, basis in points and %, annualised cost-of-carry vs MIBOR, and 20-day percentile bands per underlying (NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, top SSF). Surfaces cash-and-carry/reverse-arb windows and warns when basis collapses (squaring-off pressure) or balloons (event premium). Today I'm flying blind on whether the future is rich or cheap relative to fair value.

feature_requests.title: Roll-Day Calendar & Roll-Spread Cost Tracker (T-5 to expiry)
feature_requests.rationale: Expiry-month calendar showing days-to-expiry, current roll spread (next − current) in points and annualised %, roll-percentage completed (next-month OI / total OI), and historical roll-cost percentile for each underlying. Tells me whether to roll early (cheap spread, low % rolled) or wait, and surfaces backwardated rolls that signal stress. Critical from T-5 onwards; absent today.

feature_requests.title: SPAN+ELM Margin vs Notional Efficiency Table (live)
feature_requests.rationale: Per open/proposed futures leg show SPAN, exposure, ELM, additional margin, total blocked margin, notional value, and leverage ratio (notional/margin), with portfolio aggregate and headroom vs broker limit. Also previews margin shock on +/-2% / +/-5% underlying moves. Lets me size new futures without breaching margin and spot inefficient hedges that block disproportionate margin.

feature_requests.title: EOD Mark-to-Market Preview & Settlement Cash-Flow Estimator (3:25 PM cutoff)
feature_requests.rationale: At 3:20 IST surface every open futures position with entry price, current LTP, estimated settlement price (last 30-min VWAP), expected MTM debit/credit per leg, aggregate cash impact tonight, and post-settlement carry margin requirement. Flags positions whose MTM debit would breach next-day margin so I can trim before close. No view of overnight cash impact today — settlement surprises are a real risk.

feature_requests.title: RS-vs-NIFTY50 Leaderboard (Mansfield + IBD-style rank, daily + weekly)
feature_requests.rationale: Compute Mansfield RS and IBD-style 1-3-6-12 month percentile RS for the full F&O + NIFTY 500 universe vs NIFTY 50, with a 4-week rank delta column to surface emerging leaders before they're obvious. Filter to RS > 80 AND rising for the swing watchlist; this is the single most-used pre-trade screen for positional equity and is currently absent.

feature_requests.title: Multi-Timeframe Stage Scanner (Weinstein Stage 1/2/3/4 across D/W/M)
feature_requests.rationale: Classify each NIFTY 500 name into Weinstein stage on daily, weekly, and monthly bars using price vs 30W-SMA slope and 40W-SMA, then flag only names in Stage 2 across all three timeframes (true MTF alignment). Output a table with stage, weeks-in-stage, and stage-transition dates so the trader can buy fresh Stage 1->2 breakouts and avoid late-Stage-2 chases.

feature_requests.title: Earnings & Corporate-Action Calendar Overlay on Open Positions
feature_requests.rationale: For every open swing position show next earnings date, days-to-event, historical avg gap on results day, ex-dividend date, and any board meeting / split / bonus within the holding horizon. Auto-flag positions with earnings inside 5 trading days so the trader can decide to trim, hedge, or hold through the event instead of being blindsided.

feature_requests.title: FII/DII Cash & F&O Flow Tape with 5/20-Day Regime Classifier
feature_requests.rationale: Daily panel showing FII cash, DII cash, FII index-futures net long-short, FII index-options net delta, plus 5-day and 20-day rolling sums with percentile bands. Classify the flow regime (Risk-On / Risk-Off / Distribution / Accumulation) and tag every new swing entry with the prevailing regime so post-trade attribution can show which regimes actually pay for breakout buying.

feature_requests.title: Stock-Level RRG Quadrant for Open Positions + Shortlist (weekly, 8-week tails)
feature_requests.rationale: Existing weekly RRG covers sector indices; swing trader also needs single-stock RRG vs NIFTY 50 for current holdings and shortlist candidates to spot Leading->Weakening rotation early and trim before the move dies. Render quadrant with 8-week tails, position size proportional to deployed capital, and an alert when a holding crosses from Leading into Weakening.

feature_requests.title: Intraday Sector Dispersion & Capital-Rotation Heatmap (5-min)
feature_requests.rationale: Per-sector intraday breadth (% members > VWAP, sector return, advance/decline, cumulative ATR-normalized move) refreshed every 5 minutes with a leader/laggard pair board. Scalpers rotate capital toward the dispersing sector before the move matures; current palace has sector RRG (weekly) and pulse breadth but no minute-grained dispersion view that says 'IT is leading, FMCG is bleeding, rotate now'.

feature_requests.title: News-Shock Circuit-Breaker & Re-Entry Cooldown Guard
feature_requests.rationale: Detect per-symbol intraday vol-spike (range > 3x 5-min ATR or tick velocity > 5σ in 60s) plus headline-tag (corp action, block deal, regulator news), auto-flag affected symbols as HALT-NEW-ENTRIES with a 15-min cooldown, and require explicit override. Scalpers get destroyed walking into a news gap after a halt — current palace tracks tape speed but has no shock-classification or entry-block workflow tying news to size.

feature_requests.title: Vol-Per-Minute Regime Tape (σ/min rolling 15m & day-percentile)
feature_requests.rationale: Live tape per symbol of realized σ-per-minute computed over rolling 1/5/15 min windows, plotted vs the symbol's 20-day intraday baseline by time-of-day bucket, with regime labels (DEAD / NORMAL / HOT / OVERHEATED). Scalp size should scale inversely with σ; right now size sits on ATR(14)-daily which lags intraday regime shifts by hours.

feature_requests.title: Partial-Fill & Queue-Position Economics Report (post-trade)
feature_requests.rationale: Per scalp log intended size, filled size, average fill price vs touch, queue-jump count (re-pricing), unfilled slippage cost, and aborted-entry rate by setup. Aggregate into a daily report ranking setups by fill-quality decay. Scalping P&L dies from partial fills more than from being wrong; the existing cost-edge ledger covers gross-vs-net but not execution-quality decomposition.

feature_requests.title: Unified Exposure & Leverage Cockpit (Cash + F&O Notional, Beta-Adjusted, Margin Utilization)
feature_requests.rationale: Today positions, straddles, and pyramid options live in separate views — no single screen shows total gross/net notional, beta-weighted delta to NIFTY, SPAN+exposure margin used vs available, and leverage ratio (notional/equity). Without it I size the next trade blind to aggregate risk; with it I instantly see whether I can add a 30-lot BANKNIFTY position or I'm already over 4x leveraged.

feature_requests.title: Edge Attribution Waterfall by Setup Family × Regime (R-multiple decomposition)
feature_requests.rationale: The monthly report shows P&L but not WHY — I need a waterfall splitting realized R into (signal edge) × (sizing) × (slippage) × (timing) × (regime tailwind) bucketed by setup family (ORB, breakout, straddle, pyramid, swing) and FII/DII regime label. This tells me which strategies to scale, which to mute, and whether last month's PnL was edge or beta to a Risk-On tape.

feature_requests.title: Plan-vs-Actual Adherence Tracker (Premarket Basket → Executed Trades diff)
feature_requests.rationale: Premarket basket builder, screener signals, and shortlist all propose trades — but there's no scorecard showing what I PLANNED to take vs what I ACTUALLY took vs what I SKIPPED-and-it-worked. A daily adherence % plus skipped-winner P&L estimate exposes whether I'm sabotaging the plan with discretionary overrides, and quantifies the cost of FOMO entries outside the basket.

feature_requests.title: Real-Time Risk Budget Burn Meter (Daily Loss Limit, Per-Strategy Drawdown, Heat Map)
feature_requests.rationale: MAX_DAILY_LOSS_PCT exists as a hard gate but I have no live gauge showing % of daily loss budget consumed, per-strategy drawdown vs strategy's allotted heat, and projected end-of-day burn at current trade pace. Without it I discover I'm at 80% of daily stop only when RiskGuard blocks the next order; with it I throttle proactively at 50%.

feature_requests.title: Capital Deployment Timeline (Intraday cash-flow chart: idle → deployed → realized → idle)
feature_requests.rationale: I need a stacked-area chart showing minute-by-minute how my 5L capital is sliced across cash positions, options premium paid, margin blocked, and free cash — overlayed with realized P&L curve. Reveals dead capital windows (e.g. 11am–1pm idle while screener fires signals) and whether pyramid adds are starving the equity book of margin headroom.

feature_requests.title: Live IV Surface & Skew Snapshot (4 expiries, 25Δ put-call skew, term structure)
feature_requests.rationale: Need a single panel showing IV per strike across the next 4 weekly/monthly expiries for NIFTY+BANKNIFTY+SENSEX with 25Δ put-vs-call skew, ATM term-structure curve (contango/backwardation), and IV-rank vs 30-day high/low per expiry. Without this I'm blindly selling premium — can't tell if I'm short a rich skew or a cheap one, or if the front-week is unusually pumped vs next-week.

feature_requests.title: Realised-vs-Implied Volatility Tracker (5/15/30-min realised σ vs ATM IV)
feature_requests.rationale: Live chart per underlying of rolling realised vol (5m/15m/30m/EOD annualised) overlaid on ATM IV with the RV/IV ratio and z-score band. Tells me in real-time whether straddle sellers are being paid (IV>RV) or bled (RV>IV), and flags gamma-scalping windows when RV spikes intraday while IV hasn't repriced yet.

feature_requests.title: Multi-Leg Payoff Diagram with Greeks Heatmap (T+0/T+1/expiry slices)
feature_requests.rationale: For any open or hypothetical combo (straddle, strangle, IC, vertical, pyramid stack) render the P&L payoff at T+0/T+1/T+2/expiry plus a greeks overlay (net delta, gamma, theta, vega, vanna) across underlying±5% with break-evens and max-loss zones shaded. Today I read greeks as scalars — I need to SEE how gamma explodes on Tuesday morning vs Monday evening for the same position.

feature_requests.title: Auto-Hedge Suggester on Delta Drift (Δ-threshold trigger → futures/strike hedge plan)
feature_requests.rationale: When net portfolio delta drifts beyond ±0.15 per lot of underlying notional (configurable), surface a hedge proposal: N futures lots, OR cheapest OTM option to neutralise, with cost-per-delta and theta-cost ranking. Should also detect when a short straddle has gone directional and propose the converting-leg roll (e.g., roll the tested side up/down to re-center). Manual delta-management is where I leak the most.

feature_requests.title: Expiry-Day Pin-Risk Radar & Max-Pain Drift Tape
feature_requests.rationale: Tuesday/Thursday morning panel showing live max-pain strike, OI-weighted pin probability per strike (top 5), spot's distance from each, and the gamma-exposure (GEX) profile flipping sign — plus alerts when spot enters a 0.25% band around max-pain in the last 90 min. Pin risk on short straddles near expiry is the single biggest tail I face and I currently eyeball it from broker terminals.

feature_requests.title: Live Futures Basis & Cost-of-Carry Tape (current + next month, NIFTY/BANKNIFTY/SENSEX + top SSFs)
feature_requests.rationale: Need a live panel showing futures-spot basis in points and bps, annualised implied cost-of-carry vs risk-free + dividend yield, and a fair-value band. Flags when current-month trades premium/discount outside 1σ — entry trigger for cash-futures arb or basis trades. Today I eyeball this on Kite; should be one glance on AlphaDesk.

feature_requests.title: Roll-Spread Calendar & Rollover % Tracker (T-7 to expiry)
feature_requests.rationale: Panel showing days-to-expiry for current contracts, live near-far roll spread (in pts + annualised), cumulative rollover % vs prior 3-month avg at same T-minus, and cost-of-roll per lot. Surfaces unusual rollover behaviour (low rollover = bearish positioning, expensive roll = squeeze) and warns me which positions need to be rolled vs squared before expiry.

feature_requests.title: SPAN+ELM Margin Efficiency Table (margin-per-lot, notional-per-rupee, hedge offsets)
feature_requests.rationale: For every tradeable futures contract show SPAN+ELM+exposure margin per lot, notional exposed, leverage ratio, and the margin benefit of common hedges (long fut + short fut next month, fut + protective put). Lets me pick the contract giving the best notional-per-rupee and size correctly against MAX_POSITION_SIZE_PCT without surprise margin calls.

feature_requests.title: Cash-Futures Arbitrage Scanner with Reverse-Arb & Dividend-Adjusted Edge
feature_requests.rationale: Continuously scan F&O universe for basis dislocations net of borrow cost, brokerage, STT, and upcoming dividends; rank top 10 cash-buy-fut-sell (and reverse) opportunities with annualised yield, lot-level capital needed, and expiry pickup. Currently invisible in AlphaDesk — easy 8–12% annualised when index basis spikes around events.

feature_requests.title: RS-vs-NIFTY Leaderboard with Mansfield RS + 1/3/6M Percentile Rank
feature_requests.rationale: Daily NIFTY 500 leaderboard ranking names by Mansfield RS (price/NIFTY ratio normalized vs 52w) plus 1M/3M/6M return percentiles and new-RS-high flag. Lets me allocate fresh capital only to top-decile RS leaders and rotate out of names dropping below median. Critical input for swing entries — weak-RS breakouts fail twice as often.

feature_requests.title: Fresh-Breakout vs Extended-from-Base Classifier (NR7, VCP, pivot distance)
feature_requests.rationale: Per shortlist name compute pivot-buy-point, current % above pivot, base depth/length, NR7 + VCP contraction count, and label ACTIONABLE / EXTENDED / WAIT. Stops me from chasing names already 8%+ above the buy point where R:R is broken, and surfaces fresh actionable bases I'd otherwise miss.

feature_requests.title: Sector RRG (RS-Ratio vs RS-Momentum) with Weekly 8-Week Tails — Sector Level
feature_requests.rationale: Stock-level RRG exists; need the sector-level companion: 11 NSE sectoral indices plotted on RRG quadrant vs NIFTY 500 with weekly 8-week tails. Drives top-down allocation — only hunt setups in Leading/Improving quadrants. Pairs with existing stock RRG for full top-down → bottom-up flow.

feature_requests.title: Swing-Position Earnings & Catalyst Heatmap (next 30 days, T-7 risk alert)
feature_requests.rationale: Existing event-overlay flags per-position events; need an aggregate calendar heatmap showing all open swing positions across next 30 trading days with earnings/dividend/AGM clustering, and a T-7 'reduce-size' alert per position. Lets me pre-emptively trim oversized exposure to event-heavy weeks instead of getting blindsided.

feature_requests.title: FII/DII Cash-Flow Regime Gauge for Swing Hold-Period (20/60-day, NIFTY overlay)
feature_requests.rationale: Existing flow tape is 5/20-day intraday-flavored; swing traders need a 20/60-day cumulative FII+DII cash flow chart overlaid on NIFTY 50, with regime labels (FII-Buying-DII-Selling = strong, both-selling = defensive). Sets the macro tilt for position sizing and gross exposure caps over multi-week holds.

feature_requests.title: Opening-Range Breakout Tracker (5m & 15m) with Live Status Grid
feature_requests.rationale: Per liquid intraday-universe symbol show 5m & 15m OR high/low, current price vs OR, volume vs 20-day OR-volume, breakout/failed-breakout/inside-bar state, and time-since-break. Scalpers need the single board that flags 'ORB-LONG fresh, ORB-LONG faded, ORB-SHORT extended' so we hunt only fresh, volume-confirmed breaks instead of chasing 11:00 AM stale moves.

feature_requests.title: Level-2 Depth & Bid-Ask Imbalance Heatstrip (top-5 levels)
feature_requests.rationale: Live per-symbol bid/ask qty at top-5 levels, cumulative imbalance ratio, spoof-flicker detector (orders pulled <500ms), and microprice deviation from mid. Decides whether to lift the offer or join the bid — without this, scalper entries are blind to queue economics and adverse selection at thin levels.

feature_requests.title: Opening-Range Retest & VWAP-Reclaim Map (post-break behaviour)
feature_requests.rationale: After an OR break, classify each symbol's follow-through: clean trend, OR-retest-and-go, VWAP-reclaim reversal, or failed break. Track historical win-rate by pattern per symbol over last 60 sessions. Scalpers profit from the second entry, not the first — this surfaces high-quality retest setups with backed expectancy.

feature_requests.title: Intraday Capital-Rotation Leaderboard ($-volume velocity, 15m & 60m)
feature_requests.rationale: Rank intraday universe by rupee-volume traded per minute vs 20-day same-time-of-day baseline, with rotation arrows showing where flow moved in last 15/60min. Tells the scalper which 5 names own the tape RIGHT NOW so attention/risk concentrates on liquid, active stocks instead of dead movers.

feature_requests.title: Gap-Fill Probability & First-Hour Reversion Stat Card (per symbol)
feature_requests.rationale: For every gapped-open name show gap-size in ATR, historical fill-by-10:15 probability bucketed by gap-size & prior-day-context, and current % of gap filled. Drives the fade-vs-follow decision in the first 30 minutes where scalpers make/lose most of the day's edge.

def classify_breakout(*, entry: float, pivot: float, closes: list[float], highs: list[float], lows: list[float]) -> BreakoutClassification:
